item.title: Canara Bank appoints Hardeep Singh Ahluwalia as interim MD and CEO - FinanceNeoteric
item.description: Canara Bank appoints Executive Director Hardeep Singh Ahluwalia as interim MD and CEO from January 2026 following the retirement of K Satyanarayana Raju.

item.title: Bitcoin crosses $91,000 as ether, dogecoin and major altcoins extend early 2026 rally - FinanceNeoteric
item.description: Bitcoin rises above $91,000 as ether, solana, XRP and dogecoin gain, driven by short liquidations and improved risk sentiment amid Venezuela developments.

item.title: Avanse Financial Services raises Rs 1,200 crore through rights issue - FinanceNeoteric
item.description: Avanse Financial Services raises Rs 1,200 crore via a rights issue from Warburg Pincus, Kedaara Capital, and Alpha Investment to scale education lending and partnerships.

item.title: Payment infrastructure startup Mylapay raises $1 million ahead of Series A - FinanceNeoteric
item.description: Payment infrastructure startup Mylapay raises $1 million from CDM Capital, Credit Saison and new investors to scale its acquiring platform and expand globally ahead of Series A.

item.title: Musk-backed xAI raises $20 billion in Series E funding - FinanceNeoteric
item.description: Elon Musk’s xAI raises $20 billion in a Series E funding round backed by Fidelity, QIA, and Valor Equity to expand data centres and scale its AI models.

item.title: Chinese AI server leader xFusion takes first step toward IPO, hires Citic Securities - FinanceNeoteric
item.description: Chinese AI server maker xFusion hires Citic Securities to begin IPO preparations as investor demand for AI and chip stocks surges in China.

item.title: PhonePe receives SEBI approval to proceed with IPO - FinanceNeoteric
item.description: PhonePe secures SEBI approval for its IPO, eyeing up to Rs 12,000 crore fundraise and a potential $15 billion valuation amid strong revenue growth.

item.title: Juspay raises $50 million from WestBridge at $1.2 billion valuation - FinanceNeoteric
item.description: Juspay raises $50 million from WestBridge Capital at a $1.2 billion valuation, becoming 2026’s first unicorn amid strong global payments growth.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: What’s in it for the middle class? - FinanceNeoteric
item.description: Budget 2026–27 offers targeted relief for the middle class through lower TCS on overseas spending, simpler tax compliance, healthcare cost cuts and education-focused measures.

item.title: Plus NineOne Media to Host CXO Summit & Awards 2026 in New Delhi - FinanceNeoteric
item.description: Plus NineOne Media has announced the CXO Summit & Awards 2026, scheduled to take place on 15 May 2026 in New Delhi.
